records.q: 一共有多少笔订单？
records.rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders LIMIT 200

records.q: 一共有多少位客户？
records.llm_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers LIMIT 200

records.q: 已完成状态的订单有多少笔？
records.rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' LIMIT 200

records.q: 被取消的订单有多少笔？
records.rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE status = '已取消' LIMIT 200

records.q: 所有订单的平均金额是多少？（保留两位小数）
records.llm_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount),2) AS avg_amount FROM orders LIMIT 200

records.q: 最贵的商品价格是多少？
records.rule_sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price FROM products LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(price),2) AS max_price FROM products LIMIT 200

records.q: 钻石等级的客户有多少人？
records.rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE level='钻石' LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers WHERE level = '钻石' LIMIT 200

records.q: 金额超过 5000 元的订单有多少笔？
records.rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') AND total_amount > 5000 LIMIT 200

records.q: GMV（已完成和已发货订单的总销售额）是多少元？
records.rule_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200

records.q: 客单价是多少元？（GMV 口径下的平均订单金额）
records.rule_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov
FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200

records.q: 上海的 GMV 是多少元？
records.rule_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE c.city='上海' AND o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS gmv
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.city = '上海' AND o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200

records.q: 每个城市各有多少笔订单？
records.rule_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 200

records.q: 每个城市的 GMV 是多少元？
records.rule_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS gmv
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 200

records.q: 各个品类的销售额是多少元？
records.rule_sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 200

records.q: 销售额排名前三的品类是哪些？
records.rule_sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = p.category_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3

records.q: 上个月（相对今天的上一个自然月）的 GMV 是多少元？
records.rule_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) = strftime('%Y-%m','now','-1 month') AND o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货')
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) = strftime('%Y-%m','now','-1 month') LIMIT 200

records.q: 最近 30 天产生了多少笔订单？
records.rule_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= date('now','-30 days') AND o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= date('now','-30 days') LIMIT 200

records.q: 手机数码品类下一共有几件商品？
records.rule_sql: SELECT cat.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN categories cat ON cat.id=p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = '手机数码' LIMIT 200

records.q: 每个客户等级的平均订单金额是多少元？
records.llm_sql:
SELECT c.level, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount),2) AS avg_amount
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 200

records.q: 销售额最高的商品是哪一件？给出商品名。
records.rule_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1

records.q: 销量（件数）最高的商品一共卖了多少件？
records.llm_sql:
SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 1

records.q: GMV 最高的城市是哪一个？
records.rule_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS gmv
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 1

records.q: 消费总额最高的客户一共消费了多少元？
records.llm_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1

records.q: 按月的 GMV 趋势是怎样的？
records.rule_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.created_at) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS gmv
FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货')
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

records.q: 本自然年（今年）的 GMV 是多少元？
records.rule_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount),2) AS amount FROM orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.created_at) = strftime('%Y','now') AND o.status IN ('已完成','已发货') LIMIT 200
records.llm_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('已完成','已发货')
  AND strftime('%Y', created_at) = strftime('%Y','now') LIMIT 200
